changes.to: Maker (COOWA, formerly Cowarobot) gives kerb weight 640 kg and gross 766 kg, 1804 x 850 x 1375 mm excluding a 1100 mm top section, a 10 kWh battery, 158 L hopper and 46 L clean-water tank, 1260 mm sweeping width, 1-5 km/h working speed and 10 km/h maximum (2.78 m/s, converted), 2320 mm turning diameter, 26% climb and 70 dB working noise. Three-wheel steer-by-wire chassis with independent suspension.

changes.from: Urban service robot on a 1-tonne three-wheel drive-by-wire chassis for sidewalk edge sweeping; shown at CIIE 6 Nov 2026.
changes.to: Compact three-wheel autonomous street sweeper for sidewalks, kerbs and narrow service roads.
